  • Class
    Description
    Departure
    Departure represents a single transport departure in the simulation.
    Finder
    Finder is a route-finding utility class that builds a graph of departures and searches for optimal routes according to given criteria (cheapest, fastest, minimum number of transfers).
    Finder.Criteria
    Optimization criteria for route selection.
    OptimalRouteData
    OptimalRouteData represents information about an optimal route between two cities.
